3) SCCs — we will include the EDPB-approved SCCs for EU transfer; if they need an EU data subprocess location we can offer EU-hosted variants on Dedicated.

I'll prepare a short counter-redline with the above and circulate. If the vendor insists on a 12-month hard cap we should escalate, but I'm confident a 13-month pilot carveout will be fine.
